text.card: A red giant 5,568 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.86 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,740 K at its surface.
